verdict.rationale: Mercury's own site claims that AI reads bills, fills in payment details automatically, and remembers past recipients so the user can approve and pay. That covers reading, auto-populating and reviewing before payment. The evidence is a single marketing sentence with no product docs or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how incoming bills are ingested (email forwarding or upload), which fields get extracted and how accurately, and any independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI read incoming bills and auto-populate payment details for my review

citations.quote: AI reads bills, populates details automatically, and remembers past recipients — so you can approve and pay in seconds.
